Include a Raspberry Pi EEPROM update in the configuration partition.

## Inputs

No artifact inputs.

## Parameters

| Name    | Default      | Description                            |
| ------- | ------------ | -------------------------------------- |
| `model` | **Required** | Target Raspberry Pi model: pi4 or pi5. |

## Scheduling

| Setting      | Value |
| ------------ | ----- |
| Priority     | `0`   |
| Dependencies | None  |

Higher priorities run first within the selected recipe set. Dependencies include
other recipes; their priorities determine execution order.

## Behavior

Copies the bundled EEPROM update and recovery files into the layer's
configuration tree. For pi4 it also includes the USB controller firmware update.
This packages the versions bundled with Rugix Bakery; it does not fetch a newer
firmware release or enroll Secure Boot keys.

## Example

For example, add the recipe to a layer derived from a compatible base:

```toml
recipes = ["core/rpi-include-firmware"]

[parameters."core/rpi-include-firmware"]
model = "pi4"
```
